feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 27 June 2026 4:02pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 27 June 2026 at 4:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong wind.


##Synopsis##

Slow-moving low to the west of the British Isles, with associated weather fronts moving eastwards.


##Wind##

Mostly south or south-southwest 5 or 6, but 6 occasionally 7 in the west at first. Becoming southwest 4 or 5 in all waters overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, but moderate or rough in the west of the area at first.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain spreading from the west this evening, becoming mainly fair later in the night and tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally moderate between this evening and tomorrow morning.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, perhaps occasionally 6 in places.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
